title: Fiuu review (2026): fees, payouts and who it suits
summary: Fiuu fees, settlement and setup costs from its own rate card, checked 23 Oct 2026, with a side-by-side HitPay comparison for Malaysian businesses.
body_markdown:
Fiuu (formerly Razer Merchant Services) is a Malaysian payment gateway with a wide range of channels: FPX, DuitNow QR, e-wallets, cards, BNPL and 7-Eleven cash. Its published rates are low on FPX (1.00%, min RM1.20) and DuitNow QR (1.05% online), but card and DuitNow payments settle once a week, on Thursdays. If you want faster payouts, HitPay pays cards and FPX in T+1 business days, charges DuitNow QR at 1.2% and domestic cards at 1.2% + RM1 online and in store, and has no signup or yearly fee.


*Fiuu rates are from*[Fiuu's merchant base-rate appendix](https://booster.fiuu.com/assets/Appendix_20260817.pdf) *, as of 23 Oct 2026. HitPay rates are from*[HitPay Malaysia pricing](https://hitpayapp.com/my/pricing) *.*


## Fiuu at a glance


-


**What it is:** a Malaysian payment gateway (formerly Razer Merchant Services) for online and offline retail.


-


**Fees:** published in a downloadable rate appendix on booster.fiuu.com (its /pricing page returns "page not found" today).


-


**Fixed costs:** RM999 one-time signup fee (waived), RM99 yearly maintenance (first year waived, RM99/year from year two).


-


**Settlement:** weekly (Thursday) for cards, DuitNow and BNPL; T+2 for domestic e-wallets; minimum settlement RM100.

## Fiuu pros and cons


-


**Pros:** low FPX (1.00%, min RM1.20, max RM2.00) and online DuitNow QR (1.05%) rates; wide channel list including 7-Eleven cash; signup fee currently waived.


-


**Cons:** weekly settlement for cards and DuitNow; RM99/year from year two; +0.25% on all channels for Shopify merchants; terminal rental RM540/year plus RM200 installation.


## Who Fiuu suits


FPX-heavy online stores with large baskets that don't mind weekly card settlement.


## Fiuu alternative: HitPay


Best if you sell online *and* in store and want money faster: DuitNow QR 1.2%, domestic cards 1.2% + RM1, cards and FPX paid out T+1 business day, other methods T+2, Tap to Pay on iPhone, terminals bought once from MYR 310 with no rental, one dashboard and one payout. Honest note: Fiuu is cheaper than HitPay on FPX and online DuitNow QR.


Compare the two side by side on our[Fiuu alternative](https://hitpayapp.com/my/fiuu-alternative) page, or see[HitPay Malaysia pricing](https://hitpayapp.com/my/pricing) ,[DuitNow QR for business](https://hitpayapp.com/my/duitnow) , our[card terminal Malaysia](https://hitpayapp.com/my/card-terminal) range and[Tap to Pay on iPhone](https://hitpayapp.com/my/tap-to-pay-malaysia) .

## Frequently Asked Questions


### How much does Fiuu charge in Malaysia?


Fiuu's published base rates (as of 23 Oct 2026) are FPX B2C 1.00% (min RM1.20, max RM2.00), online DuitNow QR 1.05%, online domestic credit cards 2.00% + RM0.45 and debit cards 1.79% + RM0.45. The RM999 signup fee is waived, and a RM99 yearly maintenance fee applies from the second year.


### How fast does Fiuu pay out?


Fiuu's appendix (as of 23 Oct 2026) says card, DuitNow QR, DuitNow Online Banking/Wallet and BNPL payments settle weekly, every Thursday, and domestic e-wallets settle T+2. Minimum settlement is RM100. HitPay pays FPX and cards in T+1 business days and other methods in T+2 business days.


### Does Fiuu charge extra for Shopify?


Yes. Fiuu's appendix (as of 23 Oct 2026) adds +0.25% MDR on all channels for merchants on Shopify. HitPay's Shopify app adds 0.5% on top of the method rate.


### Is Fiuu cheaper than HitPay?


On FPX and online DuitNow QR, yes: Fiuu lists FPX at 1.00% (min RM1.20) and DuitNow QR at 1.05%, versus HitPay's 1.8% + RM0.40 and 1.2%. On domestic credit cards HitPay (1.2% + RM1) is cheaper than Fiuu (2.00% + RM0.45) on orders above about RM69.


### What is a good Fiuu alternative for in-store payments?


HitPay takes cards at 1.2% + RM1 and DuitNow QR at 1.2% in store, on a terminal you buy once from MYR 310 with no rental, or with Tap to Pay on iPhone. Fiuu lists a RM540 annual terminal rental and RM200 installation fee.
